description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerSubscriber class, which subscribes to exception events within the OrangeHRM framework. When an exception occurs, it logs the exception message and stack trace. The class utilizes Symfony's event system and the framework's logging services.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony kernel exception events and logs exception details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping Symfony KernelEvents::EXCEPTION to the 'onExceptionEvent' handler with high priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by retrieving the exception, then logs its message and stack trace.
